description: Estimates detected pair throughput and a best-direction one-way hashing lower bound in ebit per pair and ebit per second from an existing two-qubit density matrix and background-corrected tomography, without acquisition or physical distillation.

twoQubitDensityMatrix.description: Declared output object from ReconstructTwoQubitDensityMatrix containing rho in |00>, |01>, |10>, |11> order.

entangledPairPolarizationTomography.description: The same source observation used for reconstruction: measurementDurationSec per projection and correctedCountsByProjection. Sum complete HV, DA and RL outcomes, divide each sum by the per-projection duration (not the whole scan duration) and average the three rates; works for polarizer and PBS readouts.

densityTolerance.description: Positive finite tolerance for physical 4x4 density-matrix validation; preserves 1e-9.

entanglement.distillation.estimate.disti.description: Detected background-corrected pair rate, three complete-basis rates and dispersion, subsystem entropies, directional coherent informations, best direction, hashing lower bound and detected ebit/s lower bound. No path/detector efficiency correction; zero bound is not proof of separability.

entanglement.distillation.artifact.disti.description: Markdown throughput summary and scientific caveat.
Matching PNG/SVG detected-rate and directional hashing-bound plots.
